p: Price remains the primary kick and punt returner.
His value is mostly in return-yardage leagues, with field-flipping returns that help set up scoring.
Price continues to touch the ball and make an impact on special teams
He is a returner with visible impact, relevant in leagues that score return yards.
Obviously Myles Price touching the football and being so visible of his impact
Will have a bigger offensive role Sunday with Jefferson out, in addition to his special teams impact.
Price gets more offensive opportunity, though he is still a speculative fantasy option.
